action.desc.console: Open a direct NoVNC graphical console session to the instance display via the hypervisor, allowing emergency out-of-band management even if networking or the guest OS fails.
action.desc.start: Powers on a stopped instance (SHUTOFF). Nova Compute reallocates vCPUs and memory on the hypervisor host to boot the operating system.
action.desc.stop: Shuts down and powers off the instance (ACPI shutdown / hard power-off). Releases vCPU and RAM allocations on the hypervisor while retaining disk storage and IP addresses.
action.desc.soft_reboot: Sends a graceful ACPI shutdown signal to the guest operating system, allowing processes to flush data cleanly before restarting.
action.desc.hard_reboot: Instantly power-cycles the virtual machine at the hypervisor level (Hard Reset). Recommended when the guest OS is completely unresponsive.
action.desc.pause: Freezes the execution of the instance and keeps its entire memory state in hypervisor RAM. Can be resumed immediately without reading from disk.
action.desc.unpause: Unfreezes the instance, allowing vCPUs to resume execution threads from where they were paused.
action.desc.suspend: Saves the instance's active memory state to hypervisor disk and releases physical RAM. The instance can later be resumed to its exact working state.
action.desc.resume: Reloads saved memory state from disk into hypervisor RAM and awakens a suspended instance back to ACTIVE status.
action.desc.lock: Locks the instance to prevent non-admin users from executing state-modifying actions, attachments, reboots, or deletion.
action.desc.unlock: Unlocks the instance, restoring standard administrative and management capabilities to resource owners.
action.desc.shelve: Snapshots the instance and deletes it from the hypervisor host to release all compute resources and reduce infrastructure footprint.
action.desc.unshelve: Schedules the shelved instance onto an available compute host, restoring its disk snapshot to return the server to ACTIVE status.
action.desc.rescue: Boots the instance from a temporary rescue image while attaching the original root disk as a secondary device for file system repair and recovery.
action.desc.unrescue: Tears down the rescue environment and reboots the instance normally from its original root disk.
action.desc.rebuild: Replaces the root operating system with a newly specified image while strictly preserving the instance ID, IP addresses, attached ports, and volume associations.
action.desc.reset_state: Forcibly resets the instance state directly in the Nova database without interacting with the hypervisor. Used to unstick instances stuck in transitioning or ERROR states.
action.desc.attach_volume: Hot-plugs a Cinder block storage volume into the instance via VirtIO/SCSI bus, exposing a new block device (/dev/vdb, etc.) ready for mounting.
action.desc.detach_volume: Safely detaches a Cinder block storage volume from the instance and returns it to available status.
action.desc.attach_interface: Hot-plugs a new Neutron virtual network interface (vNIC/Port) into the instance, connecting it to the specified VPC network with internal IP allocation.
action.desc.detach_interface: Detaches a network interface (vNIC) from the instance and releases or unbinds the underlying Neutron port.
action.desc.create_snapshot: Quiesces I/O and creates a consistent snapshot image of the instance root disk into Glance, usable for cloning or disaster recovery.
action.desc.resize: Upgrades or downgrades instance vCPU, memory, and disk by moving to a new Flavor. Sets state to VERIFY_RESIZE for administrator confirmation.
action.desc.confirm_resize: Confirms that the resized instance is operating correctly, discarding the old host reservation and legacy flavor resources.
action.desc.revert_resize: Cancels the resize operation and restores the instance back to its original flavor and previous host.
action.desc.change_password: Resets the administrative root/Administrator credentials inside the guest operating system via QEMU Guest Agent without restarting.
action.desc.modify_tags: Sets or removes tags on the instance for classification, filtering, and automated resource lifecycle management.
action.desc.edit_instance: Updates the display name and human-readable description of the instance in the Nova server catalog.
action.desc.migrate: Powers down the instance and moves it to another compute node selected by Nova Scheduler (Cold Migration).
action.desc.live_migrate: Migrates a running instance and its active memory to another compute node in real-time with near-zero downtime.
action.desc.delete: Permanently terminates the instance, deallocates vCPUs and RAM, reclaims IP addresses, and purges ephemeral disks.
